messages:
Mira: Hey @sam @devon — pushed fixes to PR #4567 (retries + batching). Addressed your comments, added unit tests, and put a short changelog in the PR body. I changed the retry backoff behavior; flagged the one behavioral change in the description. Eyes when you have a minute?

Sam: Quick skim — thanks. Where exactly did you tweak the backoff? I see runtime/retry.go changed from 100ms -> 200ms. Can you add a one-line comment about rationale (why 200ms)?

Mira: Yep — added the comment and extracted a tiny helper: `exponentialBackoff(base, jitter)`. Kept default at 200ms and added env flag `ENABLE_NEW_BACKOFF` so we can toggle during canary.

Devon: Did you run perf numbers or a short canary locally? Any tail latency regression to note?

Mira: Ran a local microbench and a short staging canary (10% traffic): tail p95 showed ~+2% under 2048 seq in the worst run, median unchanged. Token cost is down ~4% due to better batching + improved prefix cache hits. I summarized the measurements in the PR description and added the raw run output. Plan: 10% dedicated canary for 24h then 50% if stable.

Sam: Sounds reasonable. One nit: can you add a unit test for the KV-cache miss + retry path? That sequence is the one that triggered the original issue in prod.

Mira: Good catch — added `retry_test.go::TestKVCacheRetryPath` which asserts we don't double-increment the retry counter and that we restore cache state after the retry. Pushed the test and updated mocks. CI kicked off.

ci-bot: ci/build #4567 — all checks passed :white_check_mark:

Sam: LGTM once the nit is addressed (the inline comment) and CI passes — happy to approve then. :thumbsup:

Devon: I'll schedule the 10% canary on staging tomorrow morning after merge.

Mira: Thanks both — will squash per Sam's preference and merge once approvals are in. Ping me if anything else pops up.
